value.rationale: The inverse relation in isotone transformation monoids is markedly non-regular, forcing weighted rather than ordinary matching arguments. Exact higher degree moments and a new log-Gaussian law quantify this inhomogeneity directly for a natural rank-proportional infinite family; existence of a matching and total inverse-pair counts do not answer these questions.
